common_prompt:
Edit the selected Sumi candidate A in image1 into ONE expression portrait. Image1 is the exact approved character/body/clothing/linework/cel-shadow master: the same 46-year-old Japanese man, broad adult shoulders, black flat cap, short tousled black hair, rectangular black glasses, black moustache connected to short beard, charcoal rolled-sleeve button shirt, brown WAIST apron, dark trousers and black lace leather shoes. Do not redesign or add/remove anything. Image2 is current officially adopted SAME-EXPRESSION Sumi: reference only his emotion, age, eyelid/mouth/brow interpretation and the small meaningful arm gesture, never its old paint texture. Image3 is Sui/nagumo for approximately7-head male proportions ONLY, do not copy face/hair/physique/costume. Images4/5 are Minto/Ageha official house line/shadow language ONLY; never transfer feminine/youthful features or costumes. Role1 uses TWO references (approved new normal plus official expression), so5 references are provided deliberately. Identity and clothing/age take priority over generic appeal. Keep image1 exact head size and center, cap crown y40, soles y1510, torso position, body scale, two feet and leg stance, canvas1024x1536. Only expression and specified meaningful arm movement may change, all other pixels should remain unchanged. Preserve adult heavier eyelids, strong nose and jaw, familiar glasses shape and slight age at mouth; do not turn him into a young pretty man, don't invent wrinkles/scars. No forced asymmetry, no extra accessories. Same transparent alpha background, no haze, studio backdrop or glow; keep visible fingers anatomically correct and glasses complete. Candidate expression study, no adoption, no text. STYLE STANDARD (shisha-game cast): draw this character in the same artist's hand as the approved Minto, Ageha and Rio sprites. Japanese 2D visual-novel game art; confident dark outlines, slightly heavier on the outer silhouette and thinner inside; flat local colors with two to three clearly shaped cel-shadow steps; highlights only as a few deliberate bands on the hair and small catchlights in the eyes. No skin gloss, no airbrush gradients, no rim light or glow, no photographic texture, no pore or fabric micro-detail, no dense ornamental noise, no hundreds of thin hair strands. Limited palette: hair and skin plus three or four main colors. Keep this character's own eye, brow, nose and mouth shapes and natural age and gender differences; do not drift toward a generic AI pretty face.
HEAD-TO-BODY STANDARD: the head from the top of the hair (not counting hats, hoods or ornaments) to the chin must be about one seventh of the full height from the top of the hair to the shoe soles (about 7 heads tall). For the petite cast (Tsumugi, Mashiro, Ageha, Same-chan) it is about 5.8 heads tall instead.

expressions.instruction: SMILE: familiar warm amused mentor grin, upper teeth visible only as a small narrow band, gently smiling eyes still OPEN behind glasses, brows relaxed, not a laughing caricature. Reflect current smile's kindly dry joking. Keep left hand in waist-apron pocket. Raise the free right forearm in a modest open-palm conversational explanation as image2, palm roughly lower-chest height and no higher; five relaxed fingers, shoulder/torso/feet fixed.

SERIOUS: calm firm instruction and concentration rather than anger, mouth closed in a straight lightly downward line, eyes focused, brows lowered only mildly; current Sumi's stern teacher expression without shouting. Left hand stays pocket. Free right hand gives one index-finger-up instructional gesture as image2 near upper chest; correct folded fingers and thumb, no extra fingers. Keep torso and feet fixed.

SURPRISE: actual current Sumi astonishment: eyes visibly wider behind glasses, eyebrows slightly lifted, mouth modestly OPEN horizontally with small visible upper teeth and dark mouth interior, not giant O-mouth or terrified scream. Keep free right arm lowered as approved A, bring left hand just out of apron pocket toward upper chest/collarbone in a small startled gesture matching image2. Fingers naturally separated, no dramatic backward lean; torso/feet fixed.

THINKING: thoughtful slightly wry or bemused mentor, narrowed attentive eyes looking a little downward toward partner, closed slightly asymmetrical mouth, no broad smile; current Sumi's contemplation/dry exasperation. Right hand touches beard/chin gently as image2, left forearm lightly supports right elbow across the lower chest. Keep shoulders relaxed, head center and feet position fixed; do not squeeze cheeks or hide the face with fingers.
